what.text: This page follows refugees from Romania living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 336 Romanian refugees in Germany, 10.7% of all refugees from Romania.
Canada hosts the most Romanian refugees, followed by the United States, Germany and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Romania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 and 2005.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 4251 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 8496, at the end of 2005, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
